issues.title: The task intake check reads few deliverables and cuts some badly

evidence.quote: ["test @example"]
"estimate the fuel cost at 6" (cut at the decimal point of 6.5)
["delivered"]

issues.root_cause_hypothesis: amoeba/task/quality.py DELIVERABLE_VERBS / deliverable_phrases: only 8 verbs (run, convert, email, make, save, write, list, read are not among them), and a phrase ends at any '.' — inside an email address or a decimal too. All 10 runs pass the check, so it says nothing about these tasks.

issues.title: Box 2 is never told web_search / fetch_url exist, and Box 3 grants them only to an exact alias

evidence.quote: "# Installed tools … tool: calc … tool: echo" — no web_search, no fetch_url
weather_search (tool), canonical weather_search, mapped false
the only capability_mapped event of the round (request named web_search)
BLOCKED currency_api — no rate, although web_search was registered
github_api_tool … no web_search request; nothing was found

issues.root_cause_hypothesis: Hypothesis: scripts/run_task.py:378 builds the Envelope that Box 2 sees from default_registry() (echo, calc) — D32 keeps the web tools out of Box 2 on purpose; amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:355 grant_web_tools hands web_search/fetch_url only to a role whose request normalises to web_search via aliases.yaml. Any other name for a data source (weather_search, currency_api, pdf_reader, github_*) leaves the registered web tools unused.
issues.confirm_by: Replay r1-weather with an alias weather_search → web_search (or with the web tools in the Envelope) and see whether step 1 searches and cites.
issues.possible_direction: Let Box 2 see the tools Box 3 will have, and grant by what a request needs, not by its exact name.

issues.title: No capability is ever requested as a skill (0 of 23 requests)

evidence.quote: excel_generator, kind tool
presentation-generator, kind tool; no brand-style request
spreadsheet_tool, word_doc_tool, chart_tool — all kind tool

issues.root_cause_hypothesis: Hypothesis: amoeba/config/prompts/d24_create_team.txt:29-30 defines a TOOL as something that 'acts or fetches' and a SKILL as 'know-how or a method (cost modelling, schema design…)'; producing an .xlsx / .pptx / .docx reads as acting, so it becomes a tool. Consequence for round 2: amoeba/pool/match.py rank() only compares entries of the request's kind, so anthropics/skills entries can never be candidates.
issues.confirm_by: Count kinds over more drafts; draft r1-xlsx once with a skill example in the prompt and see the kind change.
issues.possible_direction: Say in the Planner prompt that a document format or a house style is a skill, or let the pool match across kinds.

issues.title: A helper without its tool can finish 'done' from memory, with no BLOCKED line

evidence.quote: status done; the Logistics Specialist lacked route_engine; distances 185/175/185 [unverified]
"Deep Navy (#002060) … Segoe UI … Company Logo (Top Right)" — the designer lacked presentation-generator; status done

issues.root_cause_hypothesis: Hypothesis: amoeba/interp/plan_runner.py:501-513 (run_step) derives the status only from BLOCKED actions and BLOCKED marks in the text; the helper's missing_tools and the step's open capability requests are not consulted, so a step whose helper simply writes an answer anyway is 'done'.
issues.confirm_by: Compare each step's roles' missing_tools with its status: 9 'done' steps have a helper with a missing tool; in 4 the step needed that tool — r1-route 1 (routing), r1-deck 2 (slides), r1-fx-email 3 (email: 'Not sent', no BLOCKED), r1-code-run 2 (verify without the interpreter, I16).
issues.possible_direction: A step whose helper lacks a requested capability cannot be 'done' without saying what it did instead.
